message:
We were sitting in the living room, cozying up for a movie night when the power suddenly went out. In the chaos of finding candles and flashlights, I realized my phone was down to 2% battery. Talk about bad timing! 

As I scrambled to locate our go-bags and check on important documents, I couldn't help but think about how easily we can rely on our devices. That little moment reminded us all to have backup plans—like printed copies of important info and a few extra phone chargers tucked away. 

It’s those unexpected moments that can teach us to be a bit more prepared, right? How do you stay ready when technology lets us down? 😊
